name: Aoi
tagline: Tokyo in 23 minutes and Otemachi in 29 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Adachi City, served by Tsukuba Express. Journey times to the main business districts are 29 minutes to Otemachi, 37 minutes to Shinjuku, 47 minutes to Shibuya and 37 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands -0.3 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 2.4 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at -0.3 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from -0.8 m to 1.6 m, a difference of 2.4 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 3 to 5 m. All nine points within 400 m of the station fall inside the area too, and the deepest projection among them is 5 to 10 m. For storm surge, 8 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the large side for the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 1 clinic and 5 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 六町駅クリニック, about 25 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 東京拘置所医務部病院, about 27 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tsukuba Express.
congestion: Tsukuba Express runs at 151% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 青井→北千住, which includes this station. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥120,000 to ¥130,000 and 2LDK ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is among the lowest in the 23 wards. quiet surroundings pushes the figure up. On the other side, a large projected flood depth and only one line, the {line}, serving the station holds it down.

neighbours.lead: Ayase is ahead on the number of lines and the number of medical facilities, but Aoi is ahead on quiet.
neighbours.note: About 1 km from Aoi in a straight line. Ayase also has the JR Joban Line and Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line, which Aoi does not. With more lines, Ayase is the better connected of the two. To Toranomon, for instance, Ayase takes 5 minutes longer. A one-room flat, though, costs about ¥6,000 more at Ayase.

neighbours.lead: Gotanno is ahead on how easy the shopping is, but Aoi is ahead on quiet.
neighbours.note: About 1 km from Aoi in a straight line. Gotanno has the Tobu Skytree Line, a different set from Aoi. To Toranomon, for instance, Gotanno takes 6 minutes longer. On the number of places to eat out, Gotanno comes out ahead.

goodFor: People who get around by bicycle or with a pushchair
People living alone who want to hold the rent down
notFor: People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
People who want another route when service is suspended
People who want to finish their shopping on foot
People who want plenty of places to eat out
noiseSources: The 首都高速6号三郷線 viaduct runs just outside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
平方東京線 (a main road) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 4 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 6 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tsukuba Express serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the low side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
